abantlake.name: Lake Abant
abantlake.slogan: A landslide-dammed crater lake wrapped in pine and beech.
abantlake.line: A landslide dammed this mountain valley to form the lake, which lies at 1,328 m and covers 127 hectares.

yedigoller.name: Yedigöller
yedigoller.slogan: Seven lakes, each a different shade of autumn.
yedigoller.line: Landslides created the seven lakes, which have been a national park since 1965.

mengenchef.name: Mengen Chef Statue
mengenchef.slogan: The town that sent its cooks to the sultan's table.
mengenchef.line: The Mengen Cookery School, opened in 1997, trains chefs in Ottoman palace cuisine.

golcuk.name: Gölcük Nature Park
golcuk.slogan: A small lake you can walk round before the tea cools.
golcuk.line: This dam lake lies at 1,217 m, with a shore path of about 1,300 m.

justinianbridge.name: Justinian Bridge
justinianbridge.slogan: Fourteen centuries of Byzantine stonework, still standing.
justinianbridge.line: Completed in 562 AD, it is about 429 m long, and crosses the Çark stream rather than the Sakarya.
